snapshot_scope: Every public base/partitioned table with UUID organization_id for both fixture tenants, plus organizations; all columns and soft-deleted rows; no global tables or external effects
uncovered_limits: Actual multi-session locking/deadlock, concurrent acceptance/conversion and RFC races require external harness.
Ordinary dual-tenant membership fixture is prohibited by organization_members_user_id_unique; global-admin active tenant mismatch separately covered.
Missing M:N company target cannot be seeded with live FK intact; absence of any company links is a positive supported case.
Missing opportunity stage/lead physical FK targets cannot be seeded directly without violating FK; soft-deleted targets covered.
PAC, CFDI issuance, payment, REP, real fiscal activity and production deployment are not exercised.
Requires corrected candidate allowing live same-tenant M:N accessory with existing client; old 095aaade migration is expected to fail this regression.
Original converter only changes company estado_crm via lead_origen_id; M:N-only company stays Prospecto and no company cliente_id is assigned.
Full organization row snapshots are not a global database or sequence snapshot; parent should capture baseline catalog and rows before/after transaction.
